speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a psychiatric condition and a new onset movement disorder; can you describe exactly what movements you are experiencing, such as tremors, jerking, or stiffness?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is good news regarding your mental health; however, I need to know if this new movement disorder involves involuntary muscle contractions, stiffness, or shaking, and when you first noticed it after starting risperidone. Additionally, have you experienced any jaw clenching, teeth grinding, or restlessness lately?

REQUEST TEST: Basic Metabolic Panel (to rule out metabolic causes) and request images of your neck and lower limbs for examination.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced parkinsonism secondary to risperidone.
